text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Royal York Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Leader Lane Developments is constructing a 9-storey residential building at 230 Royal York Road. The site is located on the northwest corner of Royal York Road and Drummond Street. Transportation Services is requesting authorization to close the west sidewalk, and a portion of the southbound bicycle lane on Royal York Road, and a 2.9 metre wide portion of westbound curb lane on Drummond Street is required for a period of 15 months, from August 1, 2024 to October 31, 2025, to facilitate construction staging operations. Pedestrian movements on the west side of Royal York Road, abutting the site, will be maintained in a 2.1 metre wide covered and protected walkway.
